shorts_extract.hook: Same 5-for-1 math, opposite moral verdicts: how Joshua Greene's 2001 fMRI study exposed the brain's emotional alarm vs utilitarian calculator.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Greene et al. (2001 Science / 2004 Neuron): vmPFC personal-force alarm on Footbridge vs dlPFC working-memory math on Switch, plus the 2-second override lag.
shorts_extract.twist: Why high utilitarian scores can mean either effortful cognitive override OR blunted vmPFC empathy — and why 'personal muscular force as a means' is the exact tripwire.
